note: Transcription of the manufacturer datasheets of the SOT-23 bipolar transistors and MOSFETs in the B1 snapshot (jlc_catalog/2026-10-30). Each PDF was fetched on 2026-11-23 through the LCSC datasheet link the snapshot page gives and read from its rendered pin diagram; the PDFs are not committed, their SHA-256 is. Parts whose manufacturer has no reviewed alias (MDD, LRC), whose sheet has no numbered pin diagram (AO3400A, AO3401A) or that are already in the library (C2146) are not here.
